title: Human Oversight in AI for Social Safety
subject: AI-Literacy
chapter: 12. Human Oversight in AI for Social Safety
description: Comprehensive practice on when AI can decide things on its own versus when humans must stay in charge, who is accountable for AI mistakes, how parents, teachers, and school leaders oversee AI, and why the United Nations wants human control over military AI.
